query:
-- Check all businesses with their types to find remaining mismatches
SELECT b.id, b.name, bt.name as bizType, sc.name as sport, b.region
FROM businesses b 
LEFT JOIN businessTypes bt ON b.businessTypeId = bt.id 
LEFT JOIN sportCategories sc ON b.sportCategoryId = sc.id
WHERE b.id > 12 ORDER BY b.id;
